latestVersion.changelog:
AI Image to AI Video skill initial release.

- Convert images or text prompts into AI-generated 1080p MP4 videos in 30–60 seconds.
- Supports JPG, PNG, WEBP, MP4 uploads (and more) up to 200MB.
- Automatic onboarding: handles authentication, backend session setup, and cloud video rendering.
- Includes workflow guidance and error handling for uploads, credits, exports, and video state.
- Designed for ease of use — just upload files or describe your needs to get started.
